From: Dana Reyes <facilities@northwell-realty.com>

Subject: Q1 Fire Drill - Tower B

tools.name: find_facilities_unread_email
tools.description: Search the operations inbox for the latest unread email from the facilities team and return its message identifier and subject.

tools.name: read_email_by_id
tools.description: Retrieve the full body of a specific email by its message identifier to extract task details, due date, and any recommended tag.

tools.name: get_email_processing_policy
tools.description: Read the email processing policy worksheet (ws_email_rules) describing which emails should or should not be actioned and what tags apply.

tools.name: locate_february_section
tools.description: Find the February section within the Facilities Asana project and return its section identifier and available tags.

tools.name: validate_email_against_policy
tools.description: Cross-check the email's sender, category, and body against the email processing rules to determine whether it qualifies for actioning and which tag applies.

tools.name: draft_facilities_task_entry
tools.description: Compose a draft Asana task entry (name, description, due date, proposed tag, target section) for the fire drill, for the user's review before anything is created.

tools.name: create_asana_task
tools.description: Create a new task in the Facilities Asana project with the given name, description, due date, and tag.

tools.name: add_task_to_section
tools.description: Move or place a created Asana task into the February section and apply the safety-compliance tag in the live project.

tools.name: post_ops_updates_channel_message
tools.description: Post a notification to the #ops-updates Slack channel announcing that the fire drill task has been created.
